messages.subject: singular information matrix in lrm.fit (rank= 23 )
parts:
I am trying to do a binary logistic regression, following the example
on p. 296 of sflwr. I have been getting the error message:

singular information matrix in lrm.fit (rank= 23 ). Offending
variable(s): AcAni=Org

Any ideas what might be causing this error?

Thanks for your help!

~Linnea

messages.author: 3edc58ee737edd94
messages.subject: Re: [StatForLing with R] singular information matrix in lrm.fit  (rank= 23 )
parts:
Maybe this factor level is not attested in the data or perfectly
correlated with any other variable?
